tldr: This page lists the 47 organizations, companies, individuals, and agencies that submitted feedback to the Oregon Prosperity Council during its consultation process. Submitters span the private sector (Microsoft, Pacific Power), agriculture and food production (Tillamook County Creamery, Oregon Farm Bureau), labor representatives (SEIU), universities, local government, and advocacy groups, arranged chronologically by submission date.
